title: Street performers with amplifiers on Rynek
description: Every evening there are buskers on Rynek Główny with huge speakers right under our windows. It goes on well past 10pm and you can hear it through closed windows.

title: Overflowing bins on ul. Floriańska
description: The bins along ul. Floriańska are full by midday and tourists just pile cups and food boxes next to them. Seagulls and pigeons spread it all over the street.

title: Delivery vans blocking ul. Grodzka
description: Delivery vans park on ul. Grodzka well after the allowed morning window. Pedestrians and rickshaws have to squeeze around them in the middle of the street.

title: Broken lamps on Planty near Barbakan
description: Three lamps on the Planty path between Barbakan and ul. Basztowa have been out for over a week. The stretch is completely dark after 6pm.

title: Loose cobblestones by St. Mary's Basilica
description: Several cobblestones next to Kościół Mariacki are loose and wobble when you step on them. I saw an older lady trip there last Sunday.

title: Loud bars on Plac Nowy until 3am
description: The bars around Plac Nowy play music and crowds shout outside until 3am on weekends. Residents of the surrounding tenement houses cannot sleep at all.

title: Late-night music near the Okrąglak kiosks
description: Someone sets up a speaker next to the zapiekanka windows at the Okrąglak on Plac Nowy almost every night. The bass is still going at 2am.

title: Broken glass on ul. Szeroka after weekends
description: Every Monday morning ul. Szeroka is covered in broken bottles near the restaurant gardens. It is dangerous for kids and dogs walking to school.

title: E-scooters speeding on ul. Józefa sidewalk
description: Electric scooters fly down the narrow sidewalk on ul. Józefa at full speed. There is no room to step aside and I was nearly hit twice this month.

title: Taxis double-parking on ul. Krakowska
description: Taxis and ride-share cars stop in the tram lane on ul. Krakowska to pick people up. Trams are stuck behind them several times every evening.

title: Abandoned rental scooters on ul. Estery
description: A pile of rental scooters has been lying on the pavement at ul. Estery for days. Nobody from the operators has come to collect them.

title: Very long red light at Rondo Grzegórzeckie
description: Coming from ul. Grzegórzecka the light at Rondo Grzegórzeckie stays red for ages while the other directions are empty. Traffic backs up all the way to ul. Blich.

title: Pedestrian signal too short at the roundabout
description: The green for pedestrians crossing at Rondo Grzegórzeckie lasts only a few seconds. You cannot make it across with a stroller before it turns red.

title: Dark path through Park Daszyńskiego
description: The main path across Park Daszyńskiego towards ul. Fabryczna has no working lights. Many people walk there from Galeria Kazimierz in the evening.

title: Cracked pavement on ul. Grzegórzecka
description: The sidewalk on ul. Grzegórzecka is cracked and lifted by tree roots. Wheelchair users have to go onto the road.

title: Unsafe underpass at Rondo Mogilskie
description: The pedestrian underpass at Rondo Mogilskie is poorly lit and people often drink there at night. I avoid it after dark and walk the long way around.

title: Dark path through Park Krakowski
description: Half of the lamps along the main alley in Park Krakowski don't work. It feels unsafe walking home from ul. Karmelicka in the evening.

title: Lamps out around the pond in Park Krakowski
description: The lights around the pond in Park Krakowski have been off for two weeks. Joggers and dog walkers can barely see the path.

title: Night-time tram track works on ul. Królewska
description: Grinding work on the tram tracks on ul. Królewska runs from midnight until 4am. Nobody informed residents in advance.

title: Dog waste all over Plac Inwalidów lawns
description: The green squares at Plac Inwalidów are full of dog waste. There is only one dog bin and it is always overflowing.

title: Leaking hydrant on ul. Mazowiecka
description: A hydrant on ul. Mazowiecka has been leaking water onto the sidewalk since yesterday. It will turn into ice if it gets cold.

title: Cars parked on crosswalk at ul. Czarnowiejska
description: Drivers park right on the zebra crossing on ul. Czarnowiejska near AGH. Students step out between cars and drivers can't see them.

title: Deep potholes on ul. Bronowicka
description: There are several deep potholes on ul. Bronowicka between ul. Rydla and the tram stop. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid them.

title: Sunken asphalt near Bronowicka tram stop
description: The road surface has sunk next to the tram stop on ul. Bronowicka and fills with water every time it rains. Buses splash everyone waiting at the stop.

title: No crosswalk at bus stop on ul. Armii Krajowej
description: People get off the bus on ul. Armii Krajowej and run across four lanes because the nearest crossing is far away. Someone will get hurt there.

title: Illegal dumping by Bronowice Małe tram loop
description: Someone dumped old furniture and building rubble in the bushes next to the Bronowice Małe tram loop. The pile keeps growing every week.

title: Bench removed at Rondo Ofiar Katynia stop
description: The only bench at the bus stop by Rondo Ofiar Katynia was removed and never replaced. Elderly passengers have nowhere to sit while waiting.

title: Construction starting at 6am on ul. Opolska
description: The building site on ul. Opolska starts drilling and unloading trucks before 6am, even on Saturdays. The whole housing estate wakes up to it.

title: Flickering streetlights on ul. Pachońskiego
description: The streetlights along ul. Pachońskiego near the Azory blocks keep flickering on and off all night. Some of them stay completely dark.

title: Ambulance access blocked on ul. Prądnicka
description: Cars park along ul. Prądnicka by Szpital im. Jana Pawła II and block the access lane for ambulances. I watched an ambulance wait several minutes to get in.

title: Speeding cars on ul. Dobrego Pasterza
description: Drivers race down ul. Dobrego Pasterza right past the school and the church. We need speed bumps or a speed camera here.

title: Overflowing recycling bins on ul. Lublańska
description: The recycling containers by the blocks on ul. Lublańska haven't been emptied in two weeks. Plastic and cardboard are blowing all over the parking lot.

title: Broken sidewalk slabs on ul. Żmujdzka
description: Many sidewalk slabs on ul. Żmujdzka are broken or missing, leaving holes along the path. It's really hard to push a stroller or shopping cart there.
